snippet.title: The Supreme Chicken Trailer: Early Access
snippet.description:
The Supreme Chicken Trailer: Early Access

The Supreme Chicken is my first publicly available project. A short and simple game about cooking a restless chicken.

Now available on itch.io (although the game is still receiving updates)

#indiegame #itchio #comedy #game #trailer #thesupremechicken

If you want to see more about me, you can follow me on:

Instagram: @tikiztheone
